test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
‘A # B’ means ‘A is the daughter B’

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the only son of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the father-in-law of B’.

If P # Q @ R % S & T @ Q , then how is P related to T?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 #
 @
 &
 %
 
 

 Meaning
 Daughter
 Only Son
 Mother
 Father-in-law
 
 

 

Given: P # Q @ R % S & T @ Q

It means: P is the Daughter of Q, Q is the Only Son of R, R is the Father-in-law of S, S is the Mother of T, T is the Only Son of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/978c52af0b639d460a431019ebeb0964476e939d3b7f3831d56c7039fc95a631.png] 

So, P is the 'Sister' of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
